name: Fourier Intelligence
summary:
Fourier develops humanoid robots and rehabilitation robotics, connecting physical assistance with broader human–robot collaboration. Its humanoid portfolio includes the GRx bipedal family, the GR-3 series and GRW wheeled dual-arm robots. Alongside these platforms, it offers rehabilitation systems and integrated solutions for care and recovery settings.

The company supports an ecosystem of partners and developers through its Nexus network, technical resources and open-source activities. This combination gives Fourier a position across complete robot hardware, application development and specialized rehabilitation equipment. Its products address different forms of physical interaction, from controlled therapeutic movement to mobile manipulation and social assistance.
